name: Google androidtv
description: Controls an Android TV or Google TV: power, volume, keys, and opening apps. It pairs with a code the television shows.
notes: It reaches the television on two ports, one to pair and one to send keys. Both are allowed in advance for the address typed into its settings. To pair: fill in the television's address and its network card address (MAC), press Pair Device, then Enter Pin with the code the television shows. Type the MAC yourself: the module looks it up by running programs, which a hub does not allow, and it does not save the pairing if that fails. Needs a hub that keeps what a module saves. Proven against a stand-in for a television, not yet a real one.
